Name: Mizu's Buffalo
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Do you want your Riverland farm to be a little more lively? Is your favorite cheese mozzarella? This mod is for you if you like all things about water buffalo! It adds buffalo as a new [b]barn [/b]animal. 

[list]
[*]Buffalo give [b]Buffalo Milk[/b] every two days, with a chance for  [b]Large Buffalo Milk[/b] . This can be pressed into [b]Mozzarella [/b]cheese in the [b]Cheese Press. [/b]You can also make [b]Paneer[/b] cheese in the kitchen as a cooking recipe, using vinegar (or lemon if Cornucopia is installed).[/*]
[*]Buffalo drop [b]Horns[/b] every fourteen days at high friendship.[/*]
[*]Nine cooking recipes to find from the [b]Bookseller.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the [b]Special Order: Buffalo Buffalo.[/b][/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod.[/b] It allows the animal to drop a variety of animal products. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][b]Special Power Utilities[/b][/url] [b]is required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the recipe book to be dynamic between configuration options.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 3 extra recipes to find and cook up. These recipes are automatically included in the book giving the base recipes, for a total of 12. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ buffalo meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead or become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.

[color=#cc0000][b]The swimming feature is automatically disabled when you have Alternative Textures installed.[/b][/color] At the moment, Alternative Textures appears to cause swimming animals to walk on the surface of water. I will re-enable it when I find a way to patch it or when Alternative Textures updates. You can still play with buffalo, they just won't swim.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]
4. (Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
